description: Implementation of AAudioCommandQueue class managing command queue operations, including sending commands, waiting for commands, and controlling the command processing state.

classes.name: AAudioCommandQueue
classes.description: Class managing a queue of audio commands with thread synchronization.

methods.name: sendCommand
methods.description: Sends a command to the queue and waits for its reply with a timeout.

methods.name: waitForCommand
methods.description: Waits for a command to be available in the queue within a specified timeout.

methods.name: startWaiting
methods.description: Sets the queue to a running state, allowing commands to be processed.

methods.name: stopWaiting
methods.description: Stops command processing, clears the queue, and notifies waiting threads.
